grammar_focus: KS34 被动语态综合(各时态被动 was planted/is being sent/has been found + be said to/It is said that 转述被动 + 双宾语被动 I was given)(教材 L58 Key structures)主考;SD 易混动词 increase/grow、gain/earn、pick/cut + 课文 have sth done、it 强调句、a blessing in disguise(辅考)
scene: 据说弗林利这个小村里有一棵“该诅咒的树”。就因为报上提到过这棵树,所以现在来弗林利参观的人越来越多。该树是 50 年前栽在教堂附近的,但只是近几年才得到了一个坏名声。据说,谁要是触摸了这棵树,谁就会交上恶运;如果谁摘了一片树叶,谁就会死去。很多村民相信此树已经害了不少人。人们曾请求教区的牧师叫人把树砍掉,但他到现在也没有同意。他指出,由于人们从全国各地纷纷前来参观这棵树,它成了一个有用的财源。尽管有上述种种说法,但游客们还是照常摘树叶和把他们的名字刻在树干上。然而到目前为止,还没有一个人暴死呢!

grammar_card.title: 被动语态(各时态)+ is said to
grammar_card.intro: KS34 综合复习被动语态:各时态的被动 = be(相应时态)+ 过去分词——was planted(过去)、is being sent(现在进行)、has been found(现在完成)。转述用 be said to do / It is said that…(据说)。双宾语句变被动:She gave me a pen → I was given a pen。

rows: The tree was planted fifty years ago.
He is said to be a genius. / It is said that…

specialRules.rule: SD 易混动词:increase(数量增加)/ grow(生长、长大);gain(获得名声等)/ earn(挣钱);pick(摘、采)/ cut(切、割)。
have sth done 表'让某物被…(叫别人做)':have the tree cut down;强调句 It is … that … 突出被强调部分。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
options: The tourists it draws are a useful source of income
He is afraid of the curse
It is too big to cut

passage: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'. Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased. The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation. It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die. Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims. The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused. He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it. In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk. So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!

grammar_points.name: 一般/过去被动(be + 过去分词)
现在进行/完成被动(is being done / has been done)
be said to / It is said that(转述被动)
have sth done / it 强调句(辅考·课文)

stage5.stem: "The tree ___ planted near the church fifty years ago."(过去被动:被种植)
stage5.stem_cn: 这棵树是 50 年前栽在教堂附近的。

stage5.stem: "I ___ told to wait for him."(过去被动:被告知)
"The tree ___ mentioned in a newspaper."(过去被动:被提到)
"He ___ sent abroad right now."(现在进行被动:正被送出国)
"Your wallet ___ found."(现在完成被动:已被找到)
"So far, not one of them ___ struck down by sudden death."(现在完成被动:被击倒)
stage5.stem_cn: 到目前为止,还没有一个人暴死。

stage5.stem: "The village ___ said to possess a 'cursed tree'."(据说…拥有,be said to do 的 be 动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 据说这个村庄有一棵'该诅咒的树'。

stage5.stem: "It ___ said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck."(据说…,固定句型的 be 动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 据说谁要是碰了这棵树就会交厄运。

stage5.stem: "He is ___ to be a genius."(据说他是…,被动'被说成')
"I ___ a pen by my teacher yesterday."(双宾语变被动:我'被给了'一支笔)
stage5.stem_cn: 昨天老师给了我一支笔。

stage5.stem: "He ___ the vacant post by the manager."(双宾语变被动:他'被给予'那个空职)
stage5.stem_cn: 经理给了他那个空缺职位。

stage5.stem: "The number of visitors has ___ in recent years."(数量'增加、增多')
stage5.stem_cn: 近年来参观者的数量增加了。

stage5.stem: "He has gone abroad and is ___ a lot of money."('挣、赚'钱)
stage5.stem_cn: 他出国了,听说赚了很多钱。

stage5.stem: "The tree has ___ an evil reputation."('获得、得到'名声)
"The tourists have been ___ leaves from the tree."('摘、采'树叶)
stage5.stem_cn: 游客们一直在摘树上的叶子。

stage5.stem: "The vicar has been asked to have the tree ___ down."(have sth done:让树'被砍')
stage5.stem_cn: 有人请牧师把这棵树砍掉。

stage5.stem: "It is only in recent years ___ it has gained an evil reputation."(强调句型 it is … 后面的连接词)
stage5.stem_cn: 只是近几年它才得了坏名声。

stage5.stem: "Losing that job turned out to be a blessing in ___."(因祸得福、坏事变好事的固定短语)
stage5.stem_cn: 丢了那份工作结果因祸得福。
